**Introduction to Zhejiang Runhe Chemical New Material Co., Ltd.**

Zhejiang Runhe Chemical New Material Co., Ltd. is a leading innovator in the chemical industry, specializing in the research, development, production, and distribution of high-performance chemical materials. Headquartered at No. 136, Qingchun Road, Hangzhou, Zhejiang Province, China, the company has established itself as a trusted partner for global clients seeking advanced chemical solutions. With a strong commitment to technological innovation and sustainable development, Runhe Chemical has built a reputation for delivering high-quality products that meet the evolving demands of industries such as coatings, adhesives, construction, electronics, and automotive.

Founded on a foundation of scientific expertise and industrial excellence, the company leverages cutting-edge production facilities and a rigorous quality control system to ensure superior product performance and reliability. Runhe Chemical’s portfolio includes a diverse range of chemical materials, including polyurethane resins, epoxy resins, waterborne coatings, and specialty additives, all designed to enhance efficiency, durability, and environmental compliance. By fostering close collaborations with research institutions and industry leaders, the company continuously expands its technological capabilities and product offerings to stay ahead of market trends.

Beyond its technical prowess, Zhejiang Runhe Chemical prioritizes corporate responsibility, adhering to strict environmental, health, and safety standards. The company’s dedication to green chemistry and sustainable practices underscores its mission to contribute positively to both industry and society. With a customer-centric approach, a global supply chain network, and a team of highly skilled professionals, Runhe Chemical is poised to drive innovation and growth in the chemical materials sector for years to come.
